json_schema.title: grains.set
json_schema.description: Set a key to an arbitrary value. It is used like setval but works with nested keys

key.ui:title: Key
key.ui:description: Grain key to set. Use the delimiter to address nested values, for example `apps:myApp:port`

val.ui:title: Value
val.ui:description: Value to assign to the grain. Accepts simple strings or complex data like dicts/lists, for example `2209` or `{port: 2209}`

force.ui:title: Force
force.ui:description: Force writing over existing entry if given or existing values are list or dict. Defaults to False

destructive.ui:title: Destructive
destructive.ui:descripton: If an operation results in a key being removed, delete the key, too. Defaults to False

delimiter.ui:title: Delimiter
delimiter.ui:description: Specify an alternate delimiter to use when traversing a nested dict, the default being ':'
